## Update Available!
Logged out of the app? Got a new phone? It's now even easier to get back into AmaraHealth! Simply enter your registered email address, and we'll send you a one-time login link to access your account instantly - no password needed.
changelog:
## What's new in AmaraHealth™?
It's now even easier to login to AmaraHealth! Simply enter your registered email address, and we'll send you a one-time login link to access your account instantly - no password needed.
